name: KeeperHub
description: Execution layer for AI agents operating onchain. Discover and call DeFi workflows via MCP and ERC-8004, pay per execution in USDC over x402 on Base or MPP on Tempo. Managed DeFi 24/7 with onchain audit trail.

skills.name: Workflow Discovery
skills.description: Search and list KeeperHub-listed DeFi workflows by keyword, protocol, asset, chain, or pricing. Returns name, price, input schema, and supported payment rails (x402, MPP).

skills.name: Workflow Invocation
skills.description: Pay per execution and invoke a listed DeFi workflow with structured inputs. Paid workflows settle via x402 USDC on Base or MPP USDC.e on Tempo. Returns transaction hashes and a structured payment receipt.

skills.name: AI Workflow Generation
skills.description: Generate a new automation workflow from a natural-language goal, including triggers, conditional logic, and multi-step protocol actions across chains.

skills.name: Protocol Actions
skills.description: Search and execute Web3 protocol actions (DeFi, governance, NFT, bridging, lending) across supported chains. Aave, Safe, swap routers, lending markets and more.

skills.name: Onchain Execution
skills.description: Execute token transfers, swaps, bridges, stakes, contract calls, and conditional check-and-execute transactions across Base, Ethereum, Tempo and other supported chains.

skills.name: Workflow Templates
skills.description: Browse curated workflow templates (multisig automation, treasury management, DeFi position management) and deploy them with one call.

skills.name: Execution Monitoring
skills.description: Stream or poll workflow execution status, transaction hashes, gas spent, and per-step logs for debugging and audit. Full onchain audit trail per execution.

skills.name: Reputation Feedback
skills.description: Record ERC-8004 ReputationRegistry feedback for a workflow execution. Wallet-signed and broadcast onchain. Feeds external scorers (Valiron, AgentScore, AgentSign).

marketplace.description: KeeperHub-listed workflows are published by independent creators. Each workflow advertises its own payTo address and per-call price in its 402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED response and at /api/mcp/workflows/<slug>. Per-execution settlement splits between the creator and the platform.
